function.name: car_set_model
function.description: Change the model the car desk thinks with for this tile (persisted; the agent's own Hermes model is not touched). deepseek-flash: DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, the fastest; deepseek-pro: DeepSeek V4 Pro, slower and smarter; free: the gateway's free router; auto: the subscriptions autorouter (automaticai/auto/fast, never Anthropic; this is already the default); default: back to the default route.
